posts.post: A wheel you can see through
posts.what: The winch's big wheel on the block by the drum motor, once a solid brown disc, is shown rebuilt as an oak rim with four arms through a hub and thirty-six pale hornbeam cogs; the wheel's look changes, and the film does not show it meshing or doing anything new.

posts.shared: the same drum-motor block shown up close with a small crafted addition and nothing new happening
